scope: Design simulation only; physical policies obey the sibling hypothetical V2 care/inventory rules, not actual Jev. Calendar periods and game days are separate. No token-market price, mainnet gas profit, AI behavior or population forecast.

best_observed.note: One fixed NFT, empty economy, same hypothetical policy; cumulative saved exports before first250-token mint; global pressure from other players lengthens this.

assumptions.acceptanceModel: Per-op concurrent cohort batch snapshots canonical P before any settlement, not sequential accepted-and-settled requests.
assumptions.reservationModel: Atomic actual-packet reserve/settle; excludes worst-feasible-Q held during AI. Zero blocked packets is not full-request liveness proof.
